title: `maxTotalFunds()` would be inflated during each call
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `setTiers` function allows setting new tiers for sale. Internally it calls the `_setTiers` function which updates each of the tiers' values and increments `maxTotalFunds` by the sum of the new tiers' `cap` values (L483):  ```solidity File: PublicSale.sol 479:     function _setTiers(Tier[MAX_TIERS] memory _tiers) private { 480:         for (uint256 i = 0; i < MAX_TIERS; i++) { 481:             _checkTierVestDuration(_tiers[i]); 482:             tiers[i] = _tiers[i]; 483:             maxTotalFunds += _tiers[i].cap; <=@ 484:
